items.title: 13.10 Thande aur garam aabi sodium hydroxide ke saath chlorine ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Disproportionation reactions
blocks.text: Woh reactions jin mein ek hi element ek hi waqt mein oxidation (electron khona, oxidation state barhna) aur reduction (electron lena, oxidation state ghatna) dono se guzarta hai, disproportionation reactions kehlate hain.
Jab chlorine thande (cold) aur garam (hot) aqueous sodium hydroxide (NaOH) se react karti hai to disproportion hoti hai, aur reaction ke temperature ke mutabiq mukhtalif products banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Disproportionation reaction kya hai? Ek misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Jis reaction mein ek hi element ek saath oxidize aur reduce ho. Misal: thande NaOH mein Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; chlorine 0 se NaCl mein -1 (reduce) aur NaClO mein +1 (oxidize) ho jati hai.

items: Disproportionation: ek hi element ek saath oxidize aur reduce hota hai.
Chlorine NaOH mein disproportionate hoti hai; thanda NaOH: chlorate(I), garam NaOH: chlorate(V).
